players.product: on-premises superconducting quantum computers (five-qubit IQM Spark; IQM Radiance, approximately 20 to 150 qubits) and IQM Resonance cloud

quarterly_data.signal: IQM (prospectus): sells on-premises full-stack quantum computers - the five-qubit IQM Spark for education and research and the IQM Radiance in configurations from approximately 20 to 150 qubits - and is designing IQM Halocene to scale beyond 150 qubits; it describes the largest known on-premises customer base in quantum computing, with customers including high-performance computing centers, research laboratories, universities and enterprises.

connects_to.relationship: IQM QPU access distributed through Amazon Braket (Garnet, Emerald)

contracts.signal: IQM (prospectus): makes access to its quantum computers available to customers through its IQM Resonance cloud service and through Amazon Web Services' Braket.

connects_to.relationship: cryogenic systems keeping IQM quantum computers at millikelvin temperatures

contracts.signal: IQM (prospectus): uses commercially available cryogenic systems to keep its quantum systems in the millikelvin range and has an established strategic relationship with Bluefors, located in Finland, to provide cryogenics systems.
